text.approach: Reached via a multi-day backpack up the Thunder Creek Trail from Colonial Creek Campground to Park Creek Pass (roughly 40 miles round trip with on the order of 7,000 ft of cumulative gain including the bonus climb to Junction Camp), or as part of a Ptarmigan-style traverse linking Cascade Pass/Buckner/Park Creek Pass. From a Park Creek Pass-area camp, it is a short day-trip scramble up to the Booker-Buckner col and on to the summit.
text.road: {"name":"North Cascades Highway (SR 20) to Colonial Creek Campground / Thunder Creek Trailhead","status":"Paved, year-round to Colonial Creek except in unusual winter closures of SR 20 itself","driveNote":"Access via Colonial Creek Campground on SR 20 near Diablo Lake; the climb itself requires a long Thunder Creek backpack to Park Creek Pass.","seasonalGate":null}
text.overview: An alternate Class 3 scramble reached from Park Creek Pass via the Booker-Buckner col, on the mountain's northwest side; used mainly by parties already in the Park Creek/Buckner area on a multi-day traverse rather than as a dedicated approach.
text.descent: Downclimb the northwest-side Class 3 terrain back to the Booker-Buckner col, then descend the broad sandy gully (using snowbridges over any crevasses/cracks as on the ascent) back toward Park Creek Pass camp.
